items.html:
Duvvarapu Shivkumar is a right-hand batsman and medium-pacer who was part of India's Under-19 squad that won the World Cup in Malaysia in 2008. He began playing cricket in 2000 would like to be an engineer if he doesn't make it as a professional cricketer.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
